up: Retrieve data for molecules reported in document CHEMBL1158408. Return the following columns: molregno_chembl_id (ChEMBL ID of the molecule), pref_name (preferred name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Join documents to compound_records via doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary via molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1158408'. Order the results by molregno_chembl_id ascending.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molregno_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1158408' ORDER BY molregno_chembl_id ASC
